answer: Urban land registries can resist sybil attacks by binding each agent identity to a non-fungible parcel relic recorded in a distributed cadastral ledger, so duplicate claims collapse onto one deed. Every transfer is co-signed and hashed into a rolling sonnet-like chain of verified stanzas, creating an audit oasis where fake identities cannot anchor without a unique spatial token. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
